messages:
Marta: I'm opening a tiny docs PR to add an "optimize decision card" that summarizes prefetch vs micro-batch vs bulk-batch for the Optimize toolkit. Will include compact TS + Python snippets, a short qprofile compatibility note, and an ops canary checklist. Need SDK review and a quick QA harness run.

Owen: please include explicit guidance for streams: if user context is stable across requests prefer prefetch; if requests are independent but high throughput use bulk-batch. That sentence helps infra teams.

Marta: added that. TS snippet: `await client.optimize.prefetch({model:'rwd-7b-quant', prefetchKeys:['ctx'], batchSize:4, quantProfile:'q-short-v2'})`. Python equivalent will be in the PR.

Keiko: minor: mention the qprofile rename mapping (old: q-short -> q-short-v2) and a runtime fallback example routing to the non-quant model when profile missing.

sam-ci: queued QA harness: `tools/eval/harness --suite=opt-decision-card --model=rwd-7b-quant --tokens=8,64,512 --runs=20`. Please attach artifacts.

docs-bot: CI/link-check queued for PR #5199 - status: pending

Marta: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5199 — assigning @Owen and @Keiko.

docs-bot: CI/link-check completed for PR #5199 - status: success :white_check_mark:

Owen: reviewed TS snippet and left a tiny style nit. Keiko approved the qprofile mapping.

Marta: merged PR and patched a broken sidebar link. Thanks all! Closing thread.
